'''Steve Jones''' played the [[2010 Match Play Championship]].

He ran the sanctioned Star Wars CCG tournament at the N. Clinton St. Altered States store in Syracuse, New York, on 28 August 2004 ($6 entry).<ref name="pcf-3915-53388">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53388#53388 Syracuse Tounament 8/28/04], Andrew Shuman (capn_morgan), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041210031818/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53388%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On the Players Committee forum he posted as noscreenname, signing his posts "Shadow 47" (signature captured June 2006).<ref name="pcf-9928-136659">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=136659#136659 New York States 7.15], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618073001/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137582&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> In 2006 he organized Star Wars CCG events in upstate New York: the [[April 2006 Syracuse tournament|22 April 2006 tournament]] at How You Play the Game (formerly Altered States) in Syracuse,<ref name="pcf-9488-131501">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=131501#131501 next upstate local 4.22], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095904/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=135064&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> another event on 20 May 2006,<ref name="pcf-9488-134717">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=134717#134717 next upstate local 4.22], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095904/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=135064&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> and the [[2006 New York State Championship]] at the same store, 689 N. Clinton St., on 15 July 2006 ($10 entry, six games, Ultimate prize package, decklists mandatory, with a final confrontation).<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" /> In December 2005 he was listed as a member of Team Drunken Monkey, with Zach Tartell, [[Andrew Shuman]], [[Kirk England]], [[Hunter Roney]] and Jay Niedzielski.<ref name="pcf-8196-111257">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=111257#111257 Important Poll on Darth Sidious/Emperor Palpatine], LonelyBaritone (team roster in his forum signature, captured June 2006), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 December 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618091122/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=8196&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=40 Internet Archive]</ref> At the [[2008 Yavin 4 Regionals]] on 17 May 2008 he finished 7th, 8 (+32),<ref name="sf-20194-302448">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302448#p302448 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Tim Simon (Aglets), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> with a deck he called "Juggernauts".<ref name="sf-20194-304276">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=304276#p304276 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181215/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start80.html Internet Archive]</ref> In 2009 he was the tournament director of the Upstate New York 6-V card mini-con on 10 July and of the [[2009 New York State Championship]] on 11 July, both at Comix Zone in North Syracuse, New York; if he played, two other judges were to be on site.<ref name="sf-27721-415519">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=415519#p415519 New York States weekend], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 May 2009).</ref><ref name="sf-27721-423418">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=423418#p423418 New York States weekend], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 June 2009).</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Steve Jones (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 6]], dated 2009 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: Volunteer of the Year 2008 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Steve Jones|Card Credits]].
